activity-log.description: Capability set for the activity-log (Recent Changes) secondary window built in commands/activity.rs and routed to ActivityLog.svelte in main.ts. Needs event IPC for the activity:list / activity:append stream plus close + set-focus. ActivityLog's <header> is a Tauri drag region (data-tauri-drag-region), so the window MUST also grant core:window:allow-start-dragging — without it the webview's start_dragging invoke is denied by the ACL and surfaces as an UnhandledRejection (Sentry HQ-SYNC-WEB-3). Supersedes the retired notification-history capability (the separate notification-history window was retired in favor of the inline NotificationFeed + this standalone Recent Changes window).

default.description: Default capability set for the HQ Sync menubar webview. The popover resizes itself as its notification content changes, and the onboarding handoff switches between the onboarding card and compact popover sizes, so core:window:allow-set-size is required for the main window. Onboarding invokes detect_ai_tools and filesystem-only detect_claude_ready through core:default; custom application commands do not require per-command capability tokens.

desktop-alt-capability.description: Capability set for the expanded desktop window. App-registered commands remain behind their native feature, path, membership, and tenant checks. Projects reads through get_local_projects and persists status through set_local_project_status and set_local_story_passes; native wrappers authorize the canonical company scope before reads or writes. Files and Knowledge accept HQ-relative paths only: native commands canonicalize them, reject cross-company resolution, refresh live membership, cap preview bytes, and retain absolute paths inside Rust for preview, reveal, and file-scoped Claude dispatch. Wildcard asset-protocol access and renderer Image.fromPath are intentionally unavailable. The embedded HQ Work chat shell (DesktopApp) also invokes the shared channel commands enumerated in messages.json — list_channels, fetch_channel, create_channel, create_group_dm, join_channel, invite_to_channel, send_channel_message, run_card_action (POST /v1/notify/channels/{id}/cards/{cardId}/actions), take_pending_setup_target (hq-desktop://setup checkout deep-link cold-start drain), list_channel_members, remove_channel_member, delete_channel (DELETE /v1/notify/channels/{id}, owner-only, confirmed in the UI before the call), mark_channel_read, and the company channel tab commands get_company_tab (GET /v1/companies/{uid}/tabs/{tab}) and run_company_tab_action (POST a tab_row card action for the Team/Integrations/Settings tabs) — all authorized by core:default; keep that list in step with main.rs. The hq-desktop:// scheme is registered via tauri-plugin-deep-link on the Rust side only (macOS Info.plist + Windows protocol); URL handling happens in deep_link.rs, so the webview needs no deep-link plugin permission.

dm-banner.description: Capability set for the dm-banner custom notification window. Receives the DM payload via IPC (core:event) and invokes banner_window_ready (ready-handshake show), banner_action (re-emit notification:dm-action → App.svelte opens detail / copies prompt), and dismiss_banner (auto-timeout / close). Without this file the banner's invoke()/listen calls silently fail the capability check and the window (created visible:false, shown only by the handshake) never appears. Mirrors dm-detail.json.

dm-detail.description: Capability set for the dm-detail secondary window. Receives the DM event via IPC (core:event) and invokes the dm_detail_window_ready handshake + show/focus. Without this file the window's invoke()/listen calls silently fail the capability check, so dm_detail_window_ready never reaches Rust and the window (created visible:false, shown only by the handshake) never appears — the symptom is clicking 'Open details' on a DM notification doing nothing. The window reuses the shared <Conversation/>, so it also invokes the shared messaging commands fetch_dm_thread + send_dm and, for US-025 Reactions UI, toggle_reaction (POST add / DELETE remove /v1/notify/reactions) + fetch_reactions (GET /v1/notify/reactions) + set_active_conversation (registers which conversation + message ids are open so the SINGLE DM poll path can re-fetch reactions on a 'reaction' wake); the reaction realtime event message:reaction is emitted by that poll path and authorized by core:event:default. All custom commands are authorized by core:default (custom commands are not gated by per-command permission identifiers — only plugins are). Mirrors share-detail.json / messages.json. shell:allow-open is required because the shared <Conversation/> renders DM bodies through renderMessageBodyMarkdown, whose markdown-link and autolink branches emit <a target="_blank"> anchors; tauri-plugin-shell's injected click listener intercepts those anchors and invokes plugin:shell|open with no .catch(), so without the grant the click is inert and the ACL denial surfaces as an uncatchable UnhandledRejection (Sentry HQ-DESKTOP-4F). The plugin's default open scope (https?://, mailto:, tel:) already covers every scheme safeHref admits, so no plugins.shell scope block is added to tauri.conf.json.

drift-detail.description: Capability set for the drift-detail secondary window. Needs event IPC to receive the DriftReport from Rust + permission to invoke the handshake / restore commands. Without this file, invoke() calls from the window silently fail at the capability check — the symptom is a window that stays stuck on its loading state because drift_window_ready never reaches Rust.

meeting-permissions.description: Capability set for the meeting-permissions wizard window. Self-fetches state via `meetings_permissions_state` and deep-links to System Settings panes via `permissions_open_settings` — no event-handshake needed.

meetings-window.description: Capability set for the Upcoming Meetings detail window. Needs to invoke meetings_* commands directly (self-fetches data, no main-window handshake).

messages.description: Capability set for the dedicated Messages window (US-009). The shell self-fetches its data via app-registered Tauri commands authorized by core:default (custom commands are not gated by per-command permission identifiers in this ACL — only plugins are), so no allow-* tokens are added for them. The window invokes: messages_window_ready (ready-handshake show/focus), open_messages_window (focus from within), list_contacts, list_company_members, get_unread_summary, plus the shared messaging commands fetch_dm_thread + send_dm (the conversation pane reuses the DM thread + composer) and send_dm_to_email (US-010 New Message compose — POSTs /v1/notify/dm by email or personUid and returns the delivered vs connection-requested discriminant), and the connection-request commands list_dm_requests + respond_dm_request (US-011 Requests segment — list_dm_requests reads GET /v1/notify/connections/requests for the pending-request cards, respond_dm_request POSTs /v1/notify/connections/{accept|decline|block} with {pairKey} and emits dm:request-update on success). US-018 Channels segment adds the channel commands list_channels (GET /v1/notify/channels), fetch_channel (GET /v1/notify/channels/{id}/messages), create_channel (POST /v1/notify/channels), join_channel (POST /v1/notify/channels/{id}/members, self), invite_to_channel (POST /v1/notify/channels/{id}/members, {personUids}), send_channel_message (POST /v1/notify/channels/{id}/messages), run_card_action (POST /v1/notify/channels/{id}/cards/{cardId}/actions with a client-generated idempotencyKey; 409 replay is success, 403 surfaces the permission reason on the card), take_pending_setup_target (drain a stashed hq-desktop://setup checkout deep-link), list_channel_members (GET /v1/notify/channels/{id}/members), remove_channel_member (DELETE /v1/notify/channels/{id}/members/{personUid}), delete_channel (DELETE /v1/notify/channels/{id} — owner-only; 403 CHANNEL_NOT_OWNER / 404 CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND / 409 CHANNEL_GROUP_NOT_DELETABLE map to their server error strings, and a pre-rollout API-Gateway 404 body maps to a 'server doesn't support deleting channels yet' message; the deleting client drops the row itself via the channel:removed UI wake), mark_channel_read (POST /v1/notify/channels/{id}/read), and the company channel tab commands get_company_tab (GET /v1/companies/{uid}/tabs/{tab}) and run_company_tab_action (POST a tab_row card action for the Team/Integrations/Settings tabs); the channel realtime events channel:new-message + channel:updated are emitted by the SINGLE DM poll path and authorized by core:event:default. US-022 Threads UI adds the thread commands fetch_thread (GET /v1/notify/threads?rootEventId=&scope=dm|channel[&channelId=|&withPersonUid=] — pinned root + reply list + replyCount for the right-side ThreadPanel), send_thread_reply (POST /v1/notify/dm or /v1/notify/channels/{id}/messages with an added rootEventId to post a reply), and set_active_thread (registers/clears which thread the ThreadPanel currently has open so the SINGLE poll path knows which thread to re-fetch on a 'thread' wake); the thread realtime event thread:new-reply is emitted by that SINGLE DM poll path and authorized by core:event:default. US-025 Reactions UI adds the reaction commands toggle_reaction (POST add / DELETE remove /v1/notify/reactions with {messageScope, messageId, emoji}) and fetch_reactions (GET /v1/notify/reactions?messageScope=&messageId= → [{emoji, count, reactedByMe}]), plus set_active_conversation (registers/clears which conversation + visible message ids the open Conversation pane shows, so the SINGLE poll path knows which messages to re-fetch reactions for on a 'reaction' wake); the reaction realtime event message:reaction is emitted by that SINGLE DM poll path and authorized by core:event:default. The compose recipient picker (RecipientPicker.svelte) additionally invokes meetings_list_memberships (to enumerate the caller's companies for per-company member groups). All HTTP to /v1/notify/* happens in Rust, not the webview, so no http: scope is needed here. Capability drift (a command registered in main.rs but missing from this window's capability file) is the #1 failure mode — every command callable from this window must remain listed in the description above and authorized by core:default below. Mirrors desktop-alt.json / dm-detail.json. Share integration: open_messages_window now accepts an optional deep-link target (stashed in PendingMessagesTarget and delivered via the messages:open-conversation event on ready/focus); the shell additionally invokes set_watched_shares + toggle_reaction/fetch_reactions with share:{eventId} scopes for the inline share-card bubbles merged into DM threads, fetch_notification_history (shares feed the timeline + rail previews), and open_claude_code_link (share card 'Open in Claude').

new-files-detail.description: Capability set for the new-files detail window. Receives the file-list payload via event IPC and invokes the ready handshake before the window is shown.

recovery-capability.description: Native recovery window: a bundled HTML page that can check for updates (including server-directed rollback), reinstall latest, reset local UI state, and quit. No dependency on the main Svelte bundle.

share-detail.description: Capability set for the share-detail window. Receives event list via IPC; uses window.open() (Web API, no shell plugin needed) for the HQ Console link. Share reactions + reply: the window additionally invokes toggle_reaction / fetch_reactions (messageScope 'share:{eventId}', messageId = eventId), set_watched_shares (registers the visible share eventIds with the SINGLE DM poll path so a 'reaction' wake re-fetches and emits message:reaction), and open_messages_window (the 'Message the sharer' action deep-links the Messages window with a pending conversation target). shell:allow-open is required because this window mounts the shared <DmThreadPane/> → <Conversation/> pane, which renders DM bodies through renderMessageBodyMarkdown; its markdown-link and autolink branches emit <a target="_blank"> anchors that tauri-plugin-shell's injected click listener intercepts by invoking plugin:shell|open with no .catch(), so without the grant the click is inert and the ACL denial surfaces as an uncatchable UnhandledRejection (Sentry HQ-DESKTOP-4F, whose grouping signature carries no window label). The plugin's default open scope (https?://, mailto:, tel:) already covers every scheme safeHref admits, so no plugins.shell scope block is added to tauri.conf.json.

widget.description: Capability set for the always-on-top HQ wordmark widget window (US-002) and its US-003 notification stack. Receives widget:notification / widget:occlusion events via core:event; invokes widget_ready (initial occlusion handshake) and resize_widget (grow up/left for notification rows while keeping the lower-right anchor). No extra permission entries for app commands — mirrors dm-banner.json (core:default + core:event:default cover the webview shell).
